text:
Lord

The cage has become a bird

and flown away

and my heart is mad

because it howls at death

and smiles behind the wind

at my delusions


What will I do with fear

What will I do with fear


Light no longer dances in my smile

nor do the seasons burn doves in my thoughts

My hands have stripped themselves naked

and gone where death

teaches the dead to live


Lord

The air punishes my being

Behind the air are monsters

who drink my blood


It is the disaster

It is the hour of the not-empty emptiness

It is the instant to bolt the lips

to hear the condemned scream

to contemplate each of my names

hanged in nothingness.


Lord

I am twenty years old

My eyes too are twenty years old

and yet they say nothing


Lord

I have consummated my life in an instant

The last innocence exploded

Now it is never or nevermore

or it simply was


How do I not commit suicide before a mirror

and disappear to reappear in the sea

where a great ship would await me

with its lights on?


How do I not extract my veins

and make of them a ladder

to flee to the other side of night?


The beginning has given birth to the end

Everything will continue the same

The worn smiles

The interested interest

The questions from stone to stone

The gestures that mimic love

Everything will continue the same


But my arms insist on embracing the world

because they have not yet been taught

that it is already too late


Lord

Cast away the coffins of my blood


I remember my childhood

when I was an old woman

The flowers died in my hands

because the wild dance of joy

destroyed their hearts


I remember the black mornings of sun

when I was a child

that is, yesterday

that is, centuries ago


Lord

The cage has become a bird

and has devoured my hopes


Lord

The cage has become a bird

What will I do with fear

translation.title: The Awakening
translation.editorial_note: The translation retains the poem’s repeated invocations and paradoxes, including “the not-empty emptiness” and the cage that becomes and devours as a bird.
